name: Neighbor
description: Erosion, dilation, deflate and inflate over the 3x3 neighbourhood, limited by a threshold.

params.name: coordinates
params.description: Erosion and dilation only: bit mask of the neighbours used; bit 0 = top-left, 1 = top, 2 = top-right, 3 = left, 4 = right, 5 = bottom-left, 6 = bottom, 7 = bottom-right

params.name: threshold
params.description: Largest change of a value, in 8-bit levels; 0 = unchanged (`threshold0`)
